rules: Store the exact source URL for every imported recipe.
Use only a source image whose reuse license is verified.
Do not mark an image as exact-match unless it depicts the same prepared dish.
Translate and restructure recipe instructions into Albanian without changing factual quantities, temperatures or timings.
Exclude alcohol-focused recipes from the consumer health library.
Adult recipes and baby recipes must remain separate datasets.
Baby recipes require an additional age, texture, allergen and food-safety review before publication.
